transcript.en: Hello?Jane Fairbanks speaking.
transcript.zh: 您好，我是Jane Fairbanks。

transcript.en: Oh, good morning. My name's Frank Pritchard.
transcript.zh: 哦，早上好。我是Frank Pritchard。

transcript.en: I've just retired and moved to Southoe. I'd like to become a volunteer，and I gather you co-ordinate voluntary work in the village.
transcript.zh: 我刚退休才搬到了Southoe。我想成为一名志愿者，我了解到您在乡里协调志愿工作。

transcript.en: That's right
transcript.zh: 是的。

transcript.en: What sort of thing could I do?
transcript.zh: 我能帮上什么忙吗？

transcript.en: Well, we need help with the village library. We borrow books from the town library, and individuals also donate them.
transcript.zh: 嗯，乡里的图书馆需要支持。我们从镇图书馆借书，也有一些是个人捐赠。

transcript.en: So, one thing you could do is get involved in collecting them  if you’ve got a car, that is.
transcript.zh: 因此你可以参与到采集书籍的工作中，换句话说你得有辆车。

transcript.en: Yes, that's no problem.
transcript.zh: 好的，那没问题。

transcript.en: The times are pretty flexible so we can arrange it to suit you. Another thing is the records that we keep of the books we're given,.
transcript.zh: 时间安排是非常灵活的，所以我们可以根据你的时间来。另外我们还要记录一下哪些书是捐赠来的，哪些是从镇图书馆借来并需要归还的。

transcript.en: and those we borrow and need to return to the town library. It would be very useful to have another person to help keep them up to date
transcript.zh: 这是非常有必要的需要另一个人来及时更新记录。

transcript.en: Right. I'm used to working on a computer I presume they’re computerised?
transcript.zh: 好的，我原来常常用电脑办公的 - 我猜这些记录已经电子化了吧？

transcript.en: Oh yes.
transcript.zh: 当然。

transcript.en: Is the library purpose-built? I haven’t noticed it when I’ve walked round the village.
transcript.zh: 图书馆是专门建造的吗？我在村子里转了一圈还没注意到。

transcript.en: No, we simply have the use of a room in the village hall, the West Room. It's on the left as you go in.
transcript.zh: 不，我们只是使用村委会的一个房间，西厅。你进去的时候它就在左边。

transcript.en: I must go and have a look inside the hall.
transcript.zh: 那我一定要去大厅里看看。

transcript.en: Yes, it's a nice building.
transcript.zh: 是的，这是一栋不错的建筑。

transcript.en: Do you run a lunch club in the village for elderly people? I know a lot of places do.
transcript.zh: 你们有在乡村里运营针对于老人的午餐俱乐部项目吗？据我了解很多地方都在做这件事。

transcript.en: Yes, we have a very successful club.
transcript.zh: 当然，我们做的很好呢。

transcript.en: I could help with transport, if that’s of any use.
transcript.zh: 如果需要运输工作的话我可以帮忙。

transcript.en: Ooo definitely. People come to the club from neighbouring villages, and we’re always in need of more drivers.
transcript.zh: 哦，那必须的。有些人会从附近的乡镇过来，我们一直都需要司机呢。

transcript.en: And does the club have groups that focus on a particular hobby, too?
transcript.zh: 那这个俱乐部里面也有那种兴趣小组吗？我想参加一两个

transcript.en: I could get involved in one or two, particularly if there are any art groups.
transcript.zh: 要是有艺术小组那就是最好不过了。

transcript.en: Excellent. I'll find out where we need help and get back to you.
transcript.zh: 好极了。我会去看一下我们哪里需要帮忙然后通知你的。

transcript.en: Fine. What about help for individual residents. Do you arrange that at all?
transcript.zh: 好的。有关于独居老人的服务项目吗？你们有这方面的安排吗？

transcript.en: Yes, we do it as a one-off. In fact, there’s Mrs Carroll. She needs a lift to the hospital next week,
transcript.zh: 有的，我们只有一个这样的案例。就是Carroll夫人。她下周想要搭个去医院的便车，

transcript.en: and we're struggling to find someone.
transcript.zh: 我们这边正在努力找呢。

transcript.en: When's her appointment?
transcript.zh: 她预约的什么时间呢？

transcript.en: On Tuesday. It would take the whole morning.
transcript.zh: 星期二。一上午的时间。

transcript.en: I could do that.
transcript.zh: 那我这边没问题的。

transcript.en: Oh, that would be great. Thank you.
transcript.zh: 哦，那可真是太好了。谢谢您。

transcript.en: And also, next week, we're arranging to have some work done to Mr Selsbury ’s house before he moves, as he isn’t healthy enough to do it himself.
transcript.zh: 下周 Selsbury先生搬家前我们这边已经安排好了一些工作，，他因为身体原因不能独自完成这些事

transcript.en: We've got some people to decorate his kitchen, but if you could do some weeding in his garden, that would be wonderful.
transcript.zh: 我们已经找了一些人去布置他的厨房，如果你要是可以来花园帮忙除草的话那可真是太好了。

transcript.en: OK. I'd enjoy that. And presumably the day and time are flexible.
transcript.zh: 好的 我没问题。具体的时间和日期都是灵活的对吧。

transcript.en: Oh yes. Just say when would suit you best, and we'll let Mr Selsbury know.
transcript.zh: 是的。你先告诉我你最合适的时间，我这边再通知Selsbury先生。

transcript.en: Good.
transcript.zh: 好的。

transcript.en: The volunteers group also organises monthly social events, which is a great way to meet other people, of course.
transcript.zh: 志愿团队也会在每月组织一些社交活动，当然这也是一个非常好的结交新朋友的方式。

transcript.en: Uhuh.
transcript.zh: 明白。

transcript.en: So next month, on the 19th of October, we're holding a quiz  a couple of residents are great at planning unusual ones, and we always fill the village hall.
transcript.zh: 下个月，也就是10月19日，我们组织了一个知识竞赛，居民们很擅长组织一些不同寻常形式的竞赛，所以政府大厅总是挤满了人。

transcript.en: That sounds like fun. Can I do anything to help?
transcript.zh: 听起来很有趣。我能做些什么呢？

transcript.en: Well, because of the number of people, we need plenty of refreshments for halfway through. So, if you could provide any, we'd be grateful..
transcript.zh: 嗯，因为人很多，我们比赛中途就需要很多的点心。因此如果你可以提供一些的话，那就太感谢了。

transcript.en: I'm sure I could. I'll think about what to make, and let you know.
transcript.zh: 我这边可以的。我想想我做些什么然后告诉你。

transcript.en: Thank you. Then on November the 18th, we're holding a dance, also in the village hall.
transcript.zh: 谢谢您。之后就是在11月18了，我们举办了一场舞会，也是在市政大厅。

transcript.en: We've booked a band that specialises in music of the 1930s they’ve been before, and we’ve had a lot of requests to bring them back.
transcript.zh: 我们预订了一支专精20世纪30年代音乐的乐队 - 我们之前也办过，后来我们收到了很多想要他们返场的请求。

transcript.en: I'm not really a dancer, but I’d like to do something to help.
transcript.zh: 我不太会跳舞，但是我也想提供些帮助。

transcript.en: Well, we sell tickets in advance, and having an extra person to check them at the door, as people arrive, would be good it can be quite a bottleneck if everyone arrives at once!
transcript.zh: 我们会提前售票，观众到场的时候有人在门口检票的话就最好不过了。因为一旦观众一起到场就会特别拥挤。

transcript.en: OK, I'm happy with that.
transcript.zh: 好的 我很乐于帮忙。

transcript.en: We're also arranging a New Year’s Eve party.
transcript.zh: 我们还组织了一个新年前夜聚会。

transcript.en: We're expecting that to be a really big event, so instead of the village hall, it'll be held in the Mountfort Hotel.
transcript.zh: 我们想要把它办成一场大活动，所以场地会选在Mountfort酒店而不是乡务大厅了。

transcript.en: The ...？
Mountfort. M-O-U-N-T-F-O-R-T Hotel. It isn’t in Southoe itself, but it’s only a couple of miles away
transcript.zh: Mountfort。M-O-U-N-T-F-O-R-T 酒店。它不在Southoe乡里，但也只是在几英里之外。

transcript.en: The hotel will be providing dinner and we've booked a band.
transcript.zh: 酒店会提供晚餐，我们预约了乐队。

transcript.en: The one thing we haven’t got yet is a poster. That isn’t something you could do, by any chance, is it?
transcript.zh: 只是有一件事我们至今还没有搞定就是海报。也不知道这件事你能不能帮上忙？

transcript.en: Well actually, yes. Before I retired I was a graphic designer, so that’s right up my street.
transcript.zh: 我当然可以。退休前我是个平面设计师，所以这正适合我。

transcript.en: Oh perfect! I'll give you the details, and then perhaps you could send me a draft
transcript.zh: 完美。我给你些资料，之后希望你可以给我个草图…

transcript.en: Of course.
transcript.zh: 当然。
